description: Combine 2–8 prepared surface, section and streamline view artifact IDs from the same simulation into one interactive browser workspace with selectable views and pressure/velocity fields. First prepare each with view_simulation_result, completing pending operations. Use returned engineering-view artifact_id values, not raw simulation files. This reuses verified saved views; no extraction, solver run or inferred fields. At most 64 MiB combined data. Open the returned viewer_url in a browser preserving its fragment; qualification and provenance remain visible. May return a pending operation_id instead of the finished result. Continue with get_operation at retry_after_seconds intervals; on success use result, then continue the requested workflow. Do not resubmit to check progress.
